newsitem.title: USA: Wausau Paper vessels down, no impact on production.
newsitem.headline: Wausau Paper vessels down, no impact on production.

text.p: Wausau Paper Mills Inc said on Monday that two pressure vessels at its Brokaw mill will be down for several months but will not impact paper production.

Earlier today, Wausau Paper Mills reported earnings for its fiscal 1997 first quarter ended November 30, 1996 rose to $0.30 a share from $0.20 in the same period last year. Earnings in the fiscal 1997 first quarter were trimmed by $0.04 a share from production problems at the company's Brokaw mill where two pressure vessels developed cracks reducing production of pulp.

Looking ahead, Wausau Paper Mills President Daniel King said he "expects fiscal 1997 to be an outstanding year for Wausau Paper." Pulp prices have flattened bringing stability to raw material costs, he said.
Shares of Wausau Paper Mills closed up 3/8 to 20-1/8.
